303: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
304: {
305:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
306:   struct pwc_message message;
307:   unsigned int next;
308: 
309:   if (bytes == NULL)
310:     {
311:       return -EINVAL;
312:     }
313: 
314:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
315:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
316:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
317: 
318:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
319:   if (next == g_tail)
320:     {
321:       return -EAGAIN;
322:     }
323: 
324:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
325:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
326:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
327:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
328:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
329:   g_head = next;
330:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
331:   return OK;
332: }

334: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
335: {
336:   int ret;
337: 
338:   (void)argc;
339:   (void)argv;
340:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
341:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
342:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
343:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
344:   if (ret < 0)
345:     {
346:       return -EXDEV;
347:     }
348: 
349:   for (;;)
350:     {
351:       struct pwc_message message;
352:       irqstate_t flags;
353: 
354:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
355:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
356:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
357:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
358:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
359:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
360:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
361:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
362: 
363:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
364:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
365:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
366:         {
367:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
368:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
369:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
370:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
371:               {
372:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
373:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
374:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
375:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
376:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
377:               }
378:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
379:             break;
380: 
381:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
382:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
383:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
384:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
385:               {
386:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
387:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
388:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
389:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
390:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
391:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
392:               }
393:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
394:             break;
395: 
396: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
397:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
398:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
399:               {
400:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
401:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
402:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
403:                 if (ret != OK)
404:                   {
405:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
406:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
407:                   }
408:               }
409:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
410:               {
411:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
412: 
413:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
414:               }
415:             break;
416: 
417:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
418:             bk7258_psram_dump();
419:             break;
420: 
421:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
422:             {
423: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
424:               ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,
425:                                   PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
426:                                   (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
427: #else
428:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
429: 
430:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
431:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
432:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
433:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
434: #endif
435:               if (ret != OK)
436:                 {
437:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
438:                 }
439:             }
440:             break;
441: #endif
442: 
443:           default:
444:             break;
445:         }
446:     }
447:   return 0;
448: }

395:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
396:     }
397:   else
398:     {
399:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
400:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
401:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
402:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
403:     }
404: 
405:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
406:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
407:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
408:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
409:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
410: }

412: static void begin_abort(int result)
413: {
414:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
415: 
416:   if (g_active.busy)
417:     {
418:       g_active.quarantine = true;
419:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
420:     }
421: 
422:   if (probe != NULL)
423:     {
424:       probe->quarantine = true;
425:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
426:     }
427: 
428:   fail_pending(result);
429:   g_probe_requested = false;
430:   select_recovery_epoch();
431: }

433: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
434: {
435:   unsigned int i;
436: 
437:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
438:     {
439:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
440:         {
441:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
442:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
443:         }
444:     }
445: 
446:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
447:   return NULL;
448: }
449: 
450: static int dispatch_locked(void)
451: {
452:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
453:   struct active_transaction *active;
454:   struct logical_channel *channel;
455:   unsigned int i;
456:   int ret;
457: 
458:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
459: 
460:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
461:     {
462:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
463:         {
464:           continue;
465:         }
466: 
467:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
468:       if (ret < 0)
469:         {
470:           return ret;
471:         }
472: 
473:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
474:     }
475: 
476:   if (g_reset_pending)
477:     {
478:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       g_reset_pending = false;
485:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
486:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
487:     }
488: 
489:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
490:     {
491:       return OK;
492:     }
493: 
494:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
495:     {
496:       channel = &g_channels[i];
497:       if (!channel->queued)
498:         {
499:           continue;
500:         }
501: 
502:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
503:         {
504:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
505:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
506:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
507:             {
508:               continue;
509:             }
510: 
511:           active = &epoch->probe;
512:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
513:             {
514:               return -ENOLINK;
515:             }
516:         }
517:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
518:         {
519:           active = &g_active;
520:           if (active->quarantine)
521:             {
522:               return -ENOLINK;
523:             }
524:         }
525:       else
526:         {
527:           return OK;
528:         }
529: 
530:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
531:         {
532:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
533:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
534:                  sizeof(active->message));
535:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
536:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
537:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
538:             g_channel_ids[i]);
539:         }
540: 
541:       active->callback = channel->callback;
542:       active->arg = channel->arg;
543:       active->channel_index = i;
544:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
545:       active->busy = true;
546:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
547:       if (ret < 0)
548:         {
549:           active->busy = false;
550:           return ret;
551:         }
552: 
553:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
554:         {
555:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
556:             {
557:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
558:             }
559: 
560:           g_probe_attempts++;
561:           g_stats.probes++;
562:         }
563: 
564:       return OK;
565:     }
566: 
567:   return OK;
568: }

570: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
571:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
572:   const struct active_transaction *active)
573: {
574:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
575:   uint32_t reason = 0;
576: 
577:   if (!active->busy)
578:     {
579:       return 1u;
580:     }
581: 
582:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
583:     {
584:       reason |= 2u;
585:     }
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
587:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
588:     {
589:       reason |= 4u;
590:     }
591:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
592:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
593:     {
594:       reason |= 8u;
595:     }
596:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
597:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
598:     {
599:       reason |= 16u;
600:     }
601: 
602:   return reason;
603: }
604: 
605: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
606: {
607:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
608:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
609:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
610: }
611: 
612: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
613: {
614:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
615:   struct active_transaction *active;
616:   bool replay;
617:   int result;
618:   uint32_t reason;
619: 
620: 
621:   active = busy_probe();
622:   if (active == NULL)
623:     {
624:       active = &g_active;
625:     }
626: 
627:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
628:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
629:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
630:   if (reason != 0)
631:     {
632:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
633:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
634:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
635:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
636:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
637:       return;
638:     }
639: 
640: 
641:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
642:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
643:     {
644:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
645: 
646:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
647:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
648:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
649:       return;
650:     }
651: 
652:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
653:     {
654:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
655:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
656:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
657:       return;
658:     }
659: 
660:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
661:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
662: 
663:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
664:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
665:     {
666:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
667:     }
668: 
669:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
670:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
671:   if (replay)
672:     {
673:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
674:       unsigned int i;
675: 
676:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
677:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
678:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
679:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
680:        */
681: 
682:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
683:       g_active.quarantine = false;
684:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
685:         {
686:           if (i != replay_index)
687:             {
688:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
689:             }
690:         }
691: 
692:       select_recovery_epoch();
693:       (void)dispatch_locked();
694:       return;
695:     }
696: 
697:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
698: 
699:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
700:     {
701:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
702:         {
703:           release_recovery_slots();
704:           g_recovery_index = 0;
705:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
706:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
707:         }
708:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
709:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
710:         {
711:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
712:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
713:            */
714:         }
715:       else
716:         {
717:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
718:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
719:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
720:         }
721:     }
722: 
723:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
724:            result < 0)
725:     {
726:       begin_abort(result);
727:     }
728: 
729:   (void)dispatch_locked();
730: }

732: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
733: {
734:   struct ack_slot *slot;
735:   unsigned int rx_index;
736:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
737:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
738:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
739:   uint8_t state = 0;
740:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
741: 
742:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
743: 
744:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
745:     {
746:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
747:       if (slot == NULL)
748:         {
749:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
750:           return -EAGAIN;
751:         }
752:     }
753:   else
754:     {
755:       slot = NULL;
756:     }
757: 
758:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
759:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
760:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
761:     {
762:       g_stats.bad_header++;
763:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
764:     }
765:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
766:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
767:     {
768:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
769:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           if (slot != NULL)
773:             {
774:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
775:             }
776: 
777:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
778:           return -EAGAIN;
779:         }
780:       else if (ret < 0)
781:         {
782:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
783:         }
784:     }
785:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
786:     {
787:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
788:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
789:         {
790:           if (slot != NULL)
791:             {
792:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
793:             }
794: 
795:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
796:           return -EAGAIN;
797:         }
798:       else if (ret < 0)
799:         {
800:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
801:         }
802:     }
803:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
804:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
805:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
806:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
807:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
808:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
809:     {
810:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
811:       ack_flags = 2u;
812:       ret = OK;
813:     }
814:   else
815:     {
816:       g_stats.unsupported++;
817:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
818:     }
819: 
820:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
821:     {
822:       return OK;
823:     }
824: 
825:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
826:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
827:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
828:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
829:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
830: 
831:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
832:     {
833:       g_probe_requested = true;
834:     }
835: 
836:   (void)dispatch_locked();
837:   return OK;
838: }
839: 
840: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
841: {
842:   irqstate_t flags;
843:   uint8_t control;
844: 
845:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
846:   g_stats.rx++;
847:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
848: 
849:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
850:     {
851:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
852:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
853:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
854:         {
855:           g_stats.bad_header++;
856:         }
857:       else
858:         {
859:           g_stats.resets++;
860:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
861:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
862:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
863:         }
864:     }
865:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
866:     {
867:       handle_ack(message);
868:     }
869:   else
870:     {
871:       int ret = handle_command(message);
872: 
873:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
874:         {
875:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
876:           return ret;
877:         }
878:     }
879: 
880:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
881:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
882:   return OK;
883: }

886: {
887:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
888:   int ret;
889: 
890:   (void)argc;
891:   (void)argv;

894:   nxsem_post(&g_diag_worker_ready_sem);

896:     {
897:       return -EXDEV;

902:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
903:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
904:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
905:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
906:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
907:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
908:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
909:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
910: 
911:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
912:       if (reported == state)
913:         {
914:           continue;
915:         }

922:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
923:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
924:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
925:         }
926: 
927:       if (callback != NULL)
928:         {
929:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
930:         }
931:     }
932: 
933:   return OK;

936: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
937: {
938:   int ret;
939: 
940:   (void)argc;
941:   (void)argv;
942:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
943:   g_tx_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
944:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_worker_ready_sem);
945:   if (ret < 0)
946:     {
947:       return -EXDEV;
948:     }
949: 
950:   for (;;)
951:     {
952:       struct active_transaction *probe;
953:       irqstate_t flags;
954:       bool request_probe;
955: 
956:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
957:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
958: 
959:       probe = busy_probe();
960:       if ((g_active.busy &&
961:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
962:           (probe != NULL &&
963:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
964:         {
965:           g_stats.timeout++;
966:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
967:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
968:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
969:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
970:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
971:           if (probe != NULL)
972:             {
973:               probe->quarantine = true;
974:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
975:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
976:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
977:             }
978:           else
979:             {
980:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
981:             }
982:         }
983: 
984:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
985:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
986:         {
987:           select_recovery_epoch();
988:         }
989: 
990:       (void)dispatch_locked();
991:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
992:         {
993:           g_probe_requested = false;
994:         }
995: 
996:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
997:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
998:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
999:       if (request_probe)
1000:         {
1001:           g_probe_requested = false;
1002:         }
1003: 
1004:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1005: 
1006:       if (request_probe)
1007:         {
1008:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1009:         }
1010:     }
1011: 
1012:   return OK;
1013: }

1360: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1361: {
1362:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1363:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1364: 
1365:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)

1367:       return -EINVAL;
1368:     }
1369: 
1370:   for (;;)
1371:     {
1372:       irqstate_t flags;
1373:       bool queued;
1374:       int result;
1375: 
1376:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1377:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1378:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1379:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1380:       if (!queued)
1381:         {

1383:         }

1392:        * the IRQ may not be dispatched while board_late_initialize() owns the

1394:        * same progress guarantee; otherwise CP can process 0x5 and enqueue its
1395:        * ACK while AP remains asleep waiting for an IRQ-side drain. */
1396:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();

233: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
234: {
235:   uintptr_t rdata0;
236:   uintptr_t rdata1;
237:   uintptr_t sidreg;
238:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
239:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
240: 
241:   (void)irq;
242:   (void)context;
243:   (void)arg;
244: 
245:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
246:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
247:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
248:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
249:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
250:     {
251:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
252:     }
253:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
254:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
255:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
256: 
257:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
258:     {
259:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
260:       uint32_t address;
261:       uint32_t length;
262:       uint8_t source;
263: 
264:       if (cpu == 0)
265:         {
266:           mbox_process_desc();
267:         }
268: 
269:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
270:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
271:         {
272:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
273:           mbox_trace_errors();
274:           break;
275:         }
276: 
277:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
278:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
279:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
280: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
281:       if (length == 0)
282:         {
283:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
284:             {
285:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
286:                 {
287:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
288:                 }
289: 
290:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
291:             }
292:           else
293:             {
294:               if (cpu == 0)
295:                 {
296:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
297:                   mbox_trace_errors();
298:                 }
299:             }
300: 
301:           continue;
302:         }
303: #endif
304: 
305:       if (cpu != 0)
306:         {
307:           continue;
308:         }
309: 
310:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
311:         {
312:           continue;
313:         }
314: 
315:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
316:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
317:              sizeof(desc->message));
318:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
319:       desc->used = true;
320:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
321:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
322:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);
323:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.rx_messages);
324:       mbox_process_desc();
325:     }
326: 
327:   if (cpu == 0)
328:     {
329:       mbox_process_desc();
330:     }
331: 
332:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
333:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
334:     {
335:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
336:     }
337: 
338:   return OK;
339: }

351:   up_irq_restore(flags);

354: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
355: {
356:   unsigned int i;
357: 
358:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
359:     {
360:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
361:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
362:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
363:         {
364:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
365:         }
366:     }

374:     {
375:       return;
376:     }

378:   flags = up_irq_save();
379:   *stats = g_stats;
380:   up_irq_restore(flags);

383: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
384: {
385:   int ret;
386: 
387:   if (g_mbox_ready)
388:     {
389:       return OK;
390:     }
391: 
392:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
393:   g_rx_order = 0;
394:   g_processing_order = 0;
395:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
396: 
397:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
398:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
399:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
400:    */
401: 
402:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
403:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
404:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
405:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
406: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
407:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
408:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
409:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
410:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
411: #endif
412:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
413:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
414: 
415:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
416:   if (ret < 0)
417:     {
418:       return ret;
419:     }
420: 
421:   g_mbox_ready = true;
422: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
423:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
424: #endif
425:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
426:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
427:   return OK;
428: }

430: bool bk7258_mbox_smp_ready(void)
431: {
432: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
433:   return g_mbox_ready && g_mbox_smp_ready;
434: #else
435:   return false;
436: #endif
437: }

440: int bk7258_mbox_secondary_init(void)
441: {
442:   if (!g_mbox_ready || !g_mbox_smp_ready || up_cpu_index() != 1)

448:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
449:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
450:   return OK;
451: }

157: bk7258_start(void)
158: {
159:   const uint8_t *src;
160:   uint8_t *dest;
161: 
162:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_C);
163: 
164:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
165:    * floating-point extension.
166:    */
167: 
168:   /* modifyreg32() uses a BSS-backed spinlock.  SRAM is retained across an
169:    * AP-only reset, so it must not be used before this function clears BSS.
170:    */
171: 
172:   putreg32(getreg32(NVIC_CPACR) |
173:            NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11), NVIC_CPACR);
174:   UP_DSB();
175:   UP_ISB();
176:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_CPACR);
177: 
178:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
179:     {
180:       *dest++ = *src++;
181:     }
182: 
183:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_DATA);
184: 
185:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
186:     {
187:       *dest++ = 0;
188:     }
189: 
190:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_BSS);
191: 
192:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
193:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
194:     {
195:       *dest++ = *src++;
196:     }
197: 
198:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_VECTORS);
199: 
200: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
201:   bk7258_hwspinlock_initialize();
202: #endif
203:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_SPINLOCK);
204:   bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(true);
205:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_PRIVATE);

169: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
170:                                 int result, void *arg)
171: {
172:   irqstate_t flags;
173:   uint8_t command;
174:   bool failed;
175: 
176:   (void)arg;
177:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
178:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
179:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
180:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
181:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
182: 
183:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
184:     {
185:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
186:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;

192:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
193:     }
194: 
195:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
196:     {
197:       if (!failed)
198:         {
199:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
200:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
201:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
202:         }
203:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)

212:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
213:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
214:         }
215:       else

217:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
218:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
219:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
220:             {
221:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
222:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.

304:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
305:         {
306:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
307:           failed = true;
308:           malformed = true;
309:         }
310:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
311:         {
312:           failed = true;
313:         }
314:       else if (rx_free() < length)
315:         {
316:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
317:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
318:           failed = true;
319:         }
320:       else
321:         {
322:           const uint8_t *source =
323:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
324: 
325:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
326:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
327:           if (first > length)
328:             {
329:               first = length;
330:             }
331: 
332:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
333:           if (first != length)
334:             {
335:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
336:             }
337: 
338:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
339:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
340:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
341:         }
342:     }
343:   else if (!failed)
344:     {
345:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
346:         {
347:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
348:           failed = true;
349:           malformed = true;
350:         }
351:       else
352:         {
353:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
354:         }
355:     }
356: 
357:   if (!malformed)
358:     {
359:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
360: 
361:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
362:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
363:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
364:         {
365:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
366:         }
367:     }
368: 
369:   update_local_rts();
370:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
371:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
372:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;

375: static int send_state_locked(void)
376: {
377:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
378:   int ret;

382:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
383:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
384:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
385:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);

387:     {
388:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
389:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;

402:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
403:   uint16_t first;
404:   int ret;

406:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)

408:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
409:     }

411:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)

414:     }

416:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
417:   if (first > length)
418:     {
419:       first = length;
420:     }
421: 
422:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
423:   if (first != length)
424:     {
425:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
426:     }
427: 
428:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
429:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
430:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
431:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
432:   message.payload_length = length;
433:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
434:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
435:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
436:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
437:   if (ret == OK)
438:     {
439:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
440:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
441:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
442:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
443:     }
444: 
445:   return ret;

448: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
449: {
450:   int ret;
451: 
452:   (void)argc;
453:   (void)argv;
454:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
455:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
456:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.ready_sem);

468:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
469:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
470:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);

472:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)

482:               if (g_uart.state_pending)

488:                   (void)send_data_locked();
489:                 }

493:       callback = g_uart.callback;
494:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;
495:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

497:       if (callback != NULL)

613: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
614: {
615:   irqstate_t flags;
616:   uint16_t available;
617:   uint16_t written;
618:   uint16_t first;
619: 
620:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
621:     {
622:       return -EINVAL;
623:     }
624: 
625:   if (length == 0)
626:     {
627:       return 0;
628:     }
629: 
630:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
631:   available = tx_free();
632:   written = length > available ? available : length;
633:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
634:   if (first > written)
635:     {
636:       first = written;
637:     }
638: 
639:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
640:   if (first != written)
641:     {
642:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
643:     }
644: 
645:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
646:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
647:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
648:   if (written < length)
649:     {
650:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
651:     }
652: 
653:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
654:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
655:     {
656:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
657:     }
658: 
659:   return written;

701:     }

703:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

283: static int wifi_command(uint16_t command, const void *payload,
284:                          uint16_t payload_length, void *result,
285:                          uint16_t result_size, uint16_t *result_length)

289:   struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *header;
290:   uint16_t sequence;
291:   int ret;

293:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -

323:   slot->command = command;
324:   slot->sequence = sequence;
325:   slot->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
326:   slot->transport_pending = true;
327:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
328:     {
329:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
330:     }

332:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.command_sem) == OK)
333:     {
334:     }
335: 
336:   {
337:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
338: 
339:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
340:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
341:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
342:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
343:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
344:   }
345:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
346:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
347:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
348:                        wifi_command_transport_complete, slot);
349:   if (ret < 0)
350:     {
351:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
352:       slot->owned = false;
353:       slot->transport_pending = false;

355:         irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);

357:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&

370:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
371:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);

373:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
374: 
375:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
376:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
377:       {
378:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
379:       }
380:     if (ret >= 0)

383:       }
384:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
385:   }

387:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)

389:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
390:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;

401:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);

492:   /* A peer generation change proves the old CP can no longer reference AP
493:    * command slots.  TX slots remain quarantined because DMA completion is
494:    * not proven by a CP reset.
495:    */
496: 
497:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
498:     {
499:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
500:           g_wifi.command[i].generation != generation)
501:         {
502:           *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes =
503:             BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
504:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
505:           g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending = false;
506:         }
507:     }
508:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
509:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
510:     {
511:       unsigned int index = (g_wifi.node_head + i) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
512: 
513:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
514:         {
515:           nodes[kept++] = g_wifi.nodes[index];
516:         }
517:     }
518:   memcpy(g_wifi.nodes, nodes, kept * sizeof(nodes[0]));
519:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
520:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
521:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;
522:   g_wifi.packet_head = 0;
523:   g_wifi.packet_tail = 0;
524:   g_wifi.packet_count = 0;
525:   for (i = 0; i < WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE; i++)
526:     {
527:       if (g_wifi.recycle[i].state != WIFI_RECYCLE_FREE &&
528:           g_wifi.recycle[i].generation != generation)
529:         {
530:           g_wifi.recycle[i].state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
531:         }
532:     }
533:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
534:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
535:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
536:   return true;
537: }

540: {
541:   if (length > WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT - g_wifi.scan_cache_length)
542:     {
543:       return -E2BIG;
544:     }
545: 
546:   memcpy(g_wifi.scan_cache + g_wifi.scan_cache_length, data, length);
547:   g_wifi.scan_cache_length += length;
548:   return OK;

551: static int wifi_scan_cache_event(uint16_t command, const void *data,
552:                                  size_t length)
553: {
554:   struct iw_event event;
555: 
556:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
557:   event.cmd = command;
558:   event.len = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + length;
559:   if (length > sizeof(event.u))
560:     {
561:       return -E2BIG;
562:     }
563:   memcpy(&event.u, data, length);
564:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
565: }

567: static int wifi_scan_cache_build_record(
568:   const struct bk7258_wifi_scan_record *record)
569: {
570:   struct iw_event event;
571:   struct iw_quality quality;
572:   struct iw_freq frequency;
573:   uint16_t flags;
574:   size_t ssid_length;
575:   size_t padded_length;
576:   size_t event_length;
577:   int ret;
578: 
579:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
580:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWAP;
581:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
582:   event.u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
583:   memcpy(event.u.ap_addr.sa_data, record->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
584:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
585:   if (ret < 0)
586:     {
587:       return ret;
588:     }
589: 
590:   ssid_length = strnlen(record->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
591:   padded_length = (ssid_length + 3u) & ~3u;
592:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
593:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWESSID;
594:   event.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
595:   event.u.essid.length = ssid_length;
596:   event.u.essid.pointer = (void *)(uintptr_t)sizeof(struct iw_point);
597:   event_length = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + sizeof(struct iw_point) +
598:                  padded_length;
599:   event.len = event_length;
600:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, offsetof(struct iw_event, u) +
601:                                sizeof(struct iw_point));
602:   if (ret < 0)
603:     {
604:       return ret;
605:     }
606:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(record->ssid, ssid_length);
607:   if (ret < 0)
608:     {
609:       return ret;
610:     }
611:   if (padded_length != ssid_length)
612:     {
613:       uint32_t padding = 0;
614:       ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&padding, padded_length - ssid_length);
615:       if (ret < 0)
616:         {
617:           return ret;
618:         }
619:     }
620: 
621:   memset(&quality, 0, sizeof(quality));
622:   quality.level = (uint8_t)record->rssi;
623:   quality.updated = IW_QUAL_DBM;
624:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(IWEVQUAL, &quality, sizeof(quality));
625:   if (ret < 0)
626:     {
627:       return ret;
628:     }
629: 
630:   memset(&frequency, 0, sizeof(frequency));
631:   frequency.m = record->channel;
632:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(SIOCGIWFREQ, &frequency, sizeof(frequency));
633:   if (ret < 0)
634:     {
635:       return ret;
636:     }
637: 
638:   flags = record->security == 0 ? IW_ENCODE_DISABLED : IW_ENCODE_ENABLED;
639:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
640:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWENCODE;
641:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(data);
642:   event.u.data.flags = flags;
643:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
644: }

646: static int wifi_scan_cache_fetch(void)
647: {
648:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_request request;
649:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_response response;
650:   uint16_t start = 0;
651:   uint16_t total = 0;
652:   uint16_t result_length;
653:   int ret;
654: 
655:   g_wifi.scan_cache = kmm_malloc(WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT);
656:   if (g_wifi.scan_cache == NULL)
657:     {
658:       return -ENOMEM;
659:     }
660: 
661:   do
662:     {
663:       memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
664:       request.start = start;
665:       request.max_records = BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS;
666:       memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
667:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE,
668:                          &request, sizeof(request), &response,
669:                          sizeof(response), &result_length);
670:       if (ret < 0)
671:         {
672:           printf("wifi scan page transport failed: %d\n", ret);
673:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
674:           return ret;
675:         }
676:       if (result_length != sizeof(response) || response.status != 0 ||
677:           response.page.start != start ||
678:           response.page.count > BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS ||
679:           response.page.reserved != 0 ||
680:           response.page.total < start ||
681:           response.page.count > response.page.total - start)
682:         {
683:           printf("wifi scan page invalid: status=%ld start=%u count=%u "
684:                  "total=%u length=%u\n",
685:                  (long)response.status, response.page.start,
686:                  response.page.count, response.page.total, result_length);
687:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
688:           return response.status != 0 ? response.status : -EPROTO;
689:         }
690: 
691:       if (start == 0)
692:         {
693:           total = response.page.total;
694:         }
695:       else if (response.page.total != total)
696:         {
697:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
698:           return -EPROTO;
699:         }
700: 
701:       for (uint8_t i = 0; i < response.page.count; i++)
702:         {
703:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_build_record(&response.page.records[i]);
704:           if (ret < 0)
705:             {
706:               wifi_scan_cache_clear();
707:               return ret;
708:             }
709:         }
710: 
711:       start += response.page.count;
712:       if (response.page.more != (start < total) ||
713:           (response.page.count == 0 && start < total))
714:         {
715:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
716:           return -EPROTO;
717:         }
718:     }
719:   while (start < total);
720: 
721:   g_wifi.scan_cached = true;
722:   return OK;
723: }

731:       *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)pattern_address =
732:         BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
733:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");

737: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
738:                                 uint32_t generation)
739: {
740:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
741:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
742:   uint8_t data[sizeof(g_wifi.command_data)];
743:   uint32_t event_address;
744:   uint16_t length;
745:   uint16_t copied;
746:   irqstate_t flags;
747: 
748:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
749:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
750:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
751:     {
752:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
753:       return;
754:     }
755: 
756:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
757:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
758:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
759:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
760:     {
761:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
762:       return;
763:     }
764: 
765:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
766:   length = event.length;
767:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
768:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
769:     {
770:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
771:       return;
772:     }
773: 
774:   copied = length < sizeof(data) ? length : sizeof(data);
775:   if (copied != 0)
776:     {
777:       memcpy(data, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
778:                                               WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
779:              copied);
780:     }
781:   wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
782:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
783: 
784:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
785:     {
786:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
787: 
788:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
789:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
790:         {
791:           if (copied != 0)
792:             {
793:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data, data, copied);
794:             }
795:           g_wifi.command_length = copied;
796:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
797:           g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
798:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
799:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
800:         }
801:       else
802:         {
803:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
804:         }
805:     }
806:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
807:     {
808:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
809:     }
810:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && copied >= 4)
811:     {
812:       uint16_t event_id;
813: 
814:       memcpy(&event_id, data, sizeof(event_id));
815:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
816:         {
817:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
818:         }
819:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
820:         {
821:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
822:         }
823:     }
824:   else if (event.id == 3u)
825:     {
826:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
827:     }
828:   else if (event.id == 8u)
829:     {
830:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
831:     }
832: 
833: }

836:                                   uint32_t *next, uint32_t generation)
837: {
838:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
839:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
840:   uint32_t event_address;
841:   irqstate_t flags;
842: 
843:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
844:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
845:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
846:     {
847:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
848:       return false;
849:     }
850: 
851:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
852:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
853:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
854:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
855:     {
856:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
857:       return false;
858:     }
859: 
860:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
861:   if (event.length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
862:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, event.length))
863:     {
864:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
865:       return false;
866:     }
867: 
868:   *next = cpdu.next;
869:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
870:   return true;

873: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
874:                                      uint32_t generation)
875: {
876:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
877:   uint32_t address = node->head;
878:   unsigned int count;
879: 
880:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
881:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
882:     {
883:       return;
884:     }
885: 
886:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
887:     {
888:       uint32_t next;
889:       unsigned int previous;
890: 
891:       if (!wifi_validate_command(address, &next, generation))
892:         {
893:           return;
894:         }
895:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
896:         {
897:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
898:             {
899:               return;
900:             }
901:         }
902:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
903:         {
904:           return;
905:         }
906: 
907:       addresses[count] = address;
908:       address = next;
909:     }
910: 
911:   if (address != 0)
912:     {
913:       return;
914:     }
915: 
916:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
917:     {
918:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
919:         {
920:           return;
921:         }
922: 
923:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
924:     }
925: }

1046: static void wifi_recycle_append(struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
1047:                                 uint32_t cpdu_address)
1048: {
1049:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu =
1050:     (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address;
1051:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
1052:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *pbuf;
1053: 
1054:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(*pbuf);
1055:   pbuf = (struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address;
1056: 
1057:   /* Match wdrv_txdata_sender(): CP drops one reference before pbuf_free(). */
1058: 
1059:   pbuf->ref++;
1060:   cpdu->flags |= 1u;
1061:   cpdu->next = 0;
1062:   if (node->tail != 0)
1063:     {
1064:       ((struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)node->tail)->next =
1065:         cpdu_address;
1066:     }
1067:   else
1068:     {
1069:       node->head = cpdu_address;
1070:     }
1071: 
1072:   node->tail = cpdu_address;
1073:   node->num++;
1074: }

1100: static void wifi_flush_recycle(void)
1101: {

1103:   irqstate_t flags;
1104:   int ret;
1105: 
1106:   for (;;)
1107:     {
1108:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1109:       if (g_wifi.recycle_count == 0)
1110:         {
1111:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1112:           return;
1113:         }
1114: 
1115:       entry = &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_head];
1116:       if (entry->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1117:         {
1118:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1119:         }
1120: 
1121:       if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD)
1122:         {
1123:           memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1124:           g_wifi.recycle_head = (g_wifi.recycle_head + 1) %
1125:                                 WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1126:           g_wifi.recycle_count--;
1127:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1128:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1129:           continue;
1130:         }
1131: 
1132:       if (entry->state != WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED ||
1133:           !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1134:         {
1135:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1136:           return;
1137:         }
1138: 
1139:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING;
1140:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1141:       ret = wifi_send_node_async(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, &entry->node,
1142:                                  wifi_recycle_complete, entry);
1143:       if (ret < 0)
1144:         {
1145:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1146:           if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
1147:             {
1148:               entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1149:             }
1150:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1151:         }
1152: 
1153:       return;
1154:     }
1155: }

1157: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending,
1158:                              struct wifi_net_notifications *notifications)
1159: {
1160:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
1161:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1162:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1163:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
1164:   uint32_t address = node->head;
1165:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
1166:   unsigned int count;
1167:   irqstate_t flags;
1168: 
1169:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
1170:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1171:     {
1172:       return;
1173:     }
1174: 
1175:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1176:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1177:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
1178:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation ||
1179:       pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1180:     {
1181:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1182:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1183:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1184:       return;
1185:     }
1186:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1187: 
1188:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
1189:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
1190:    */
1191: 
1192:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1193:     {
1194:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
1195:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
1196:       uint32_t next;
1197:       unsigned int previous;
1198: 
1199:       if (address == 0)
1200:         {
1201:           goto invalid;
1202:         }
1203: 
1204:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
1205:         {
1206:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
1207:             {
1208:               goto invalid;
1209:             }
1210:         }
1211: 
1212:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
1213:         {
1214:           goto invalid;
1215:         }
1216: 
1217:       addresses[count] = address;
1218:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
1219:       if (tx != NULL)
1220:         {
1221:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
1222:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1223: 
1224:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
1225:             {
1226:               goto invalid;
1227:             }
1228: 
1229:           cp_owned[count] = false;
1230:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
1231:         }
1232:       else
1233:         {
1234:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1235:           if (pending->generation !=
1236:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
1237:               !wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1238:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
1239:             {
1240:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1241:               goto invalid;
1242:             }
1243: 
1244:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
1245:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1246:           cp_owned[count] = true;
1247:           next = cpdu.next;
1248:         }
1249: 
1250:       address = next;
1251:     }
1252: 
1253:   if (address != 0)
1254:     {
1255:       goto invalid;
1256:     }
1257: 
1258:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1259:     {
1260:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1261:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
1262:         {
1263:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1264:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1265: 
1266:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1267:           if (pending->generation ==
1268:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() &&
1269:               wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
1270:             {
1271:               packet_added++;
1272:             }
1273:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1274:         }
1275:     }
1276: 
1277:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1278:   if (pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1279:     {
1280:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1281:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1282:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1283:       return;
1284:     }
1285: 
1286:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1287:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1288:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1289:     {
1290:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1291:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1292:         {
1293:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1294:         }
1295:     }
1296: 
1297:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1298:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1299:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1300:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1301:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1302:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1303: 
1304:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1305:     {
1306:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1307:         {
1308:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1309: 
1310:           notifications->tx_packets[notifications->tx_count++] = tx->packet;
1311:           tx->packet = NULL;
1312:           tx->active = false;
1313:           tx->transport_rejected = false;
1314:         }
1315:     }
1316:   if (packet_added != 0)
1317:     {
1318:       notifications->rxready = true;
1319:     }
1320:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1321:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1322:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1323:   return;
1324: 
1325: invalid:
1326:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1327:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1328:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1329:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1330: }

1333: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1334:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1335: {
1336:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1337:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1338:   irqstate_t flags;
1339: 
1340:   (void)ack_flags;
1341:   (void)arg;
1342:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1343:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1344:     {
1345:       return -EINVAL;
1346:     }
1347: 
1348:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1349:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1350:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1351:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1352:     {
1353:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1354:       return -EAGAIN;
1355:     }
1356: 
1357:   pending = &g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_tail];
1358:   memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
1359:   pending->node = node;
1360:   pending->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1361:   if (node.channel == 2)
1362:     {
1363:       struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry =
1364:         &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
1365: 
1366:       memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1367:       entry->generation = pending->generation;
1368:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_RESERVED;
1369:       pending->recycle_index = g_wifi.recycle_tail;
1370:       pending->recycle_reserved = true;
1371:       g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) %
1372:                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1373:       g_wifi.recycle_count++;
1374:     }
1375: 
1376:   g_wifi.node_tail = (g_wifi.node_tail + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1377:   g_wifi.node_count++;
1378:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1379:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1380:   return OK;
1381: }

1418:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1419:       for (;;)
1420:         {
1421:           if (bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() !=
1422:               g_wifi.reset_generation)

1424:               (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();

1426: 
1427:           nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);

1434:             }
1435: 
1436:           pending = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
1437:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1438:           g_wifi.node_count--;
1439:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1440:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1441:           if (pending.generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1442:             {
1443:               if (pending.recycle_reserved)
1444:                 {
1445:                   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1446:                   g_wifi.recycle[pending.recycle_index].state =
1447:                     WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1448:                   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1449:                 }
1450:             }
1451:           else if (pending.node.channel == 0)
1452:             {
1453:               wifi_handle_command_list(&pending.node,
1454:                                        pending.generation);
1455:             }
1456:           else if (pending.node.channel == 2)
1457:             {
1458:               wifi_handle_data(&pending, &notifications);
1459:             }
1460:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1461:         }
1462: 
1463:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1464:       wifi_notify_network(&notifications);
1465:     }
1466: 
1467:   return OK;
1468: }

1483: static int wifi_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower, netpkt_t *packet)
1484: {
1485:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = NULL;
1486:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
1487:   unsigned int length;
1488:   unsigned int i;
1489:   int ret;
1490: 
1491:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1492:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
1493:   if (!g_wifi.carrier || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1494:     {
1495:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1496:       return -ENETDOWN;
1497:     }
1498:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
1499:     {
1500:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1501:       return -EMSGSIZE;
1502:     }
1503: 
1504:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
1505:     {
1506:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active && !g_wifi.tx[i].transport_pending)
1507:         {
1508:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
1509:           break;
1510:         }
1511:     }
1512:   if (tx == NULL)
1513:     {
1514:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1515:       return -EBUSY;
1516:     }
1517: 
1518:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
1519:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1520:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
1521:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
1522:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
1523:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
1524:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
1525:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
1526:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
1527:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
1528:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
1529:   if (ret < 0)
1530:     {
1531:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1532:       return ret;
1533:     }
1534: 
1535:   tx->packet = packet;
1536:   tx->active = true;
1537:   tx->transport_pending = true;
1538:   tx->transport_rejected = false;
1539:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, 2,
1540:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1541:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
1542:                        wifi_tx_transport_complete, tx);
1543:   if (ret < 0)
1544:     {
1545:       tx->packet = NULL;
1546:       tx->active = false;
1547:       tx->transport_pending = false;
1548:     }
1549:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1550:   return ret;
1551: }

116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))

127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}

153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}

221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						bk_pm_openvela_mailbox_diag_dump();
276: 						// restart_cpu_x();
277: 						break;
278: 					}
279: 					else
280: 					{
281: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
282: 					}
283: 				}
284: 
285: 				retry_cnt++;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
289: 		}
290: 
291: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
292: 		{
293: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
294: 			{
295: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());

299: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
304: 		{
305: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
306: 		}
307: 		else
308: 		{
309: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
310: 		}
311: 	}

168: 	u16 count;
169: 	u16 length;

171: 	u16 i;
172: 
173: 	while (s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
174: 	{
175: 		rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
176: 		count = ap_bridge_tx_count();
177: 		if (!count)
178: 		{
179: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
180: 			break;
181: 		}
182: 		length = MIN(count, (u16)sizeof(data));
183: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
184: 		if (!length)
185: 		{
186: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
187: 			break;
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
191: 			data[i] = s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[(s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + i) %
192: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
193: 
194: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
195: 		if (!written)
196: 		{
197: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
198: 			break;
199: 		}
200: 		if (written < length)
201: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
202: 
203: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
204: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
205: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
206: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
207: 	}

241: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
242: 
243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		/* poll() may complete recovery in the same iteration that consumes an
251: 		 * older timeout/reset event.  The driver's current state is the final
252: 		 * authority for the MBUART gate, so a stale event cannot clear a newer
253: 		 * READY notification permanently.
254: 		 */
255: 		if (bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
256: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
257: 		else
258: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
259: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
260: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
261: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
262: 
263: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
264: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
265: 		{
266: 			if (line_length)
267: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
268: 			line_length = 0;
269: 			line_continues = false;
270: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
271: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
272: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
273: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
274: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		do
278: 		{
279: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
280: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
281: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
282: 			{
283: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
284: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
285: 				continue;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
289: 			{
290: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
291: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
292: 				{
293: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
294: 
295: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
296: 							     !line_continues);
297: 					line_length = 0;
298: 					line_continues = !complete;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		} while (input_length != 0);
302: 
303: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
304: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
305: 		{
306: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
307: 			line_length = 0;
308: 			line_continues = true;
309: 		}
310: 
311: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
312: 
313: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
314: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
315: 		{
316: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
317: 
318: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
319: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
320: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
321: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
322: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
323: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
324: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
325: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
326: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)
327: 			{
328: 				s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms = now;
329: 				BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG,
330: 					"link down event=%x queued=%u ready=%x\r\n",
331: 					events, ap_bridge_tx_count(),
332: 					s_ap_bridge.ready_flags);
333: 			}
334: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
335: 		}
336: 	}
337: }

365: 	}

381: 	if (ret != BK_OK)

384: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread);
385: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
386: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
387: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RX | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
391: 	BK_LOGI(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "init owner=MB_UART0 tx_ring=%u mode=LOG\r\n",
392: 		(unsigned)sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring));
393: 	return BK_OK;

395: init_fail_sem:

397: init_fail_mutex:

399: init_fail_vote:
400: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX, 1, 0);
401: 	return ret;

404: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
405: {
406: 	u16 written = 0;
407: 
408: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
409: 		return 0;
410: 
411: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	while (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
415: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
416: 			break;
417: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
418: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
419: 	}
420: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
421: 	if (written < length)
422: 	{
423: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
424: 	}
425: 	if (written)
426: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
427: 	return written;
428: }

223: }

225: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
226: {
227: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
228: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
229: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
230: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;
231: }
